# PiTTy v0.6.4 — tabs and fork reliability

## Tabs and Fork

- Blank `+` tab now strips startup session selectors cleanly, including `--` edge cases.
- Fork picker lists every user message and correctly selects any entry via keyboard or mouse.
- Tab strip height stays 2 with centered, padded labels and proper active/inactive styling.
- Provisional fork runtime prevents original tab subagent loss and hydrates the new tab.
- Per-tab inspector, scroll, and draft state eliminate black-pane and cross-tab leaks.
